### 1. Architecture Overview
The new `TransactionStore` and `QueueWithBatch` interfaces sit underneath practically every controller loop that relies on client-go’s informer/store/queue stack. Controllers register a `cache.SharedIndexInformer` to watch specific Kubernetes resources, which fills an internal `cache.Store`/`cache.Indexer` while enqueuing reconcile keys into a `cache.Queue` or `cache.FIFO`. Downstream processors drain those queues to reconcile objects.  
Within the audited codebases, we see this pattern:

- **Argo CD** builds filtered informers over Secrets/ConfigMaps for notification settings, delegating to `cache.SharedIndexInformer` constructors from client-go (`informersv1.NewFilteredSecretInformer` / `NewFilteredConfigMapInformer`) and using the shared indexer/queue infrastructure for event delivery and resyncs.[^argo-informers]
- **cert-manager** wraps client-go informers with bespoke factories. `internal/informers/core_filteredsecrets.go` creates dual caches (typed + metadata-only) built on top of client-go `cache.SharedIndexInformer`s, providing custom list/get semantics while still delegating to the underlying store/indexer, while `core_basic.go` exposes unmodified upstream informers.[^cm-filtered][^cm-basic]
- **Cilium** exposes a typed `Store` interface backed directly by `cache.Store`/`cache.Indexer`, so every consumer of `pkg/k8s/resource.Store[T]` ultimately depends on the new transactional store semantics in client-go.[^cilium-store]

Because the new feature hooks into `cache.Store` and `cache.Queue` semantics, each of these files will start seeing transactional/batch behavior once the `InOrderInformersBatchProcess` gate is enabled.

### 2. Detailed Analysis

#### Argo CD (`argo-cd.git`)
- **`util/notification/k8s/informers.go`**  
  Defines `NewSecretInformer` and `NewConfigMapInformer` helpers that return `cache.SharedIndexInformer` instances created via `informersv1.NewFilteredSecretInformer` / `NewFilteredConfigMapInformer`. These informers inherit client-go’s FIFO queue and store behavior under the hood, so any transactional changes to cache locking/queue popping will affect Argo’s notification settings watchers.[^argo-informers]

- **`pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go`** (metadata)  
  Implements Argo CD’s informer factory, managing `SharedIndexInformer` lifecycles, mutexes, and caching logic for every CRD Argo manages. Because it centralizes informer creation, the transactional store/queue changes will propagate through this factory to all generated informers (Applications, ApplicationSets, etc.).[^argo-factory-meta]

#### cert-manager (`cert-manager.git`)
- **`internal/informers/core_filteredsecrets.go`**  
  Builds a filtered secret informer factory. It constructs both typed and metadata `cache.SharedIndexInformer`s, registers combined event handlers, and wraps the lister to mix data from client-go’s caches and live API calls. The `filteredSecretInformer` exposes `Informer()` and `Lister()` built entirely on top of client-go cache primitives, so transactional semantics on `cache.Store`/`cache.Indexer` directly affect how cert-manager batches secret updates and keeps caches coherent.[^cm-filtered]

- **`internal/informers/core_basic.go`**  
  Provides a simpler `baseFactory`/`baseSecretInformer` that directly returns the upstream `cache.SharedIndexInformer` and `cache.SharedInformerFactory` for Secrets, Ingresses, and CSRs. Because it is a thin adapter, any change to client-go’s store or queue behavior immediately impacts these controllers’ reconciliation cadence and batching.[^cm-basic]

#### Cilium (`cilium.git`)
- **`pkg/k8s/resource/store.go`**  
  Implements a generic `Store[T]` wrapper around `cache.Store` and `cache.Indexer`. Methods such as `List`, `Get/ GetByKey`, `IndexKeys`, `ByIndex`, and `CacheStore()` delegate straight to the underlying client-go store, exposing it to the rest of the agent. This means the new `TransactionStore` semantics will surface through `typedStore`’s methods, and any components using `Store[T]` will run inside the new transaction boundary when the feature gate is on.[^cilium-store]

### 3. Relevant Files

| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| argo-cd | util/notification/k8s/informers.go | Creates filtered `cache.SharedIndexInformer`s for Secrets/ConfigMaps via client-go helpers, so it directly consumes the informer/store/queue stack affected by the new transactional interfaces.[^argo-informers] |
| argo-cd | pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go | Central informer factory (per metadata) that instantiates and manages all `SharedIndexInformer`s used by Argo CD; any feature-gated transactional behavior flows through here.[^argo-factory-meta] |
| cert-manager | internal/informers/core_filteredsecrets.go | Wraps client-go `SharedIndexInformer`s for Secrets with dual caches and custom listers, so its typed/meta caches depend on `cache.Store` semantics.[^cm-filtered] |
| cert-manager | internal/informers/core_basic.go | Thin adapter exposing upstream `cache.SharedIndexInformer`s for Secrets/Ingresses/CSRs; inherits the transactional queue/store behavior directly.[^cm-basic] |
| cilium | pkg/k8s/resource/store.go | Provides a typed wrapper over `cache.Store`/`cache.Indexer`, exposing `List`, `Get`, `ByIndex`, etc., so every consumer of this store participates in the new `TransactionStore` behavior.[^cilium-store] |

---

[^argo-informers]: `util/notification/k8s/informers.go`, lines 16‑24 (Argo CD).
[^argo-factory-meta]: `pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go` metadata summary (Argo CD).
[^cm-filtered]: `internal/informers/core_filteredsecrets.go`, lines 69‑340 (cert-manager).
[^cm-basic]: `internal/informers/core_basic.go` metadata summary (cert-manager).
[^cilium-store]: `pkg/k8s/resource/store.go`, lines 12‑114 (Cilium).

SUMMARY: Kubernetes client-go introduces TransactionStore and QueueWithBatch interfaces to enable transactional and batch processing within informer/store/queue stacks. These new interfaces extend existing cache.Store, cache.Queue, and cache.FIFO primitives used by virtually all Kubernetes controllers. The feature is gated behind InOrderInformersBatchProcess and will affect any code that wraps or uses these client-go interfaces.

FILES:
- argo-cd/util/notification/k8s/informers.go — Creates filtered cache.SharedIndexInformers for Secrets/ConfigMaps using client-go helpers, directly consuming the informer/store/queue stack affected by the new transactional interfaces.
- argo-cd/pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go — Central informer factory that instantiates and manages all SharedIndexInformers used by Argo CD, so transactional behavior flows through here.
- cert-manager/internal/informers/core_filteredsecrets.go — Wraps client-go SharedIndexInformers for Secrets with dual caches and custom listers, depending on cache.Store semantics.
- cert-manager/internal/informers/core_basic.go — Thin adapter exposing upstream cache.SharedIndexInformers for Secrets/Ingresses/CSRs, inheriting transactional queue/store behavior directly.
- cilium/pkg/k8s/resource/store.go — Provides a typed wrapper over cache.Store/cache.Indexer, exposing List, Get, ByIndex, etc., so every consumer participates in the new TransactionStore behavior.
